system.description: You sit in silence where a person died within the last day.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and you also learn the last thing they were thinking.
outcomes.success: You see and hear the last 5 minutes of their life as a spectral playback.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the time is lost.
outcomes.ruin: You feel their death as your own: you take d6 damage that cannot be reduced. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
